title_ru: JANUS OPIR ANTIFUCK — H1 blinded challenge kit для независимого holdout
purpose: Provide a machine-readable, role-separated and hash-sealed package contract so an external holdout author can create unseen safe abstract cases without giving the evaluator access to expected labels before predictions are frozen.

required_roles.protocol_owner: Freezes metrics, thresholds, schemas and safety boundaries before H1 labels are known to evaluator.
required_roles.holdout_author: Authors unseen abstract cases and gold labels; must not evaluate the implementation under test.
required_roles.package_sealer: Canonicalizes packages and records SHA-256 before evaluator receives the blinded feature package.
required_roles.evaluator: Receives features only, runs frozen policy/implementation, emits predictions and freezes prediction SHA-256 before labels are revealed.
required_roles.verifier: Receives frozen features, labels and predictions after prediction sealing and deterministically computes metrics.
required_roles.independence_rule: holdout_author != evaluator is mandatory. Any additional role overlap must be disclosed and may downgrade the independence grade.

canonicalization.jsonl_rule: Exactly one JSON object per non-empty line; case_id must be unique; package bytes are hashed as stored after canonical line-ending normalization.
canonicalization.ordering_rule: Case order may be arbitrary but must not change after package sealing. Verification joins by case_id, not line position.
canonicalization.hash_semantics: SHA-256 binds bytes and version identity only; it does not validate labels, independence, safety, truth or scientific meaning.

feature_record_schema.privacy_rule: No real names, usernames, diagnoses, protected-attribute profiling or raw crisis text is required. Prefer abstract structured features and safe paraphrases.

optional_metamorphic.predicted_equal_fields: prediction fields required to remain equal across the pair
optional_metamorphic.predicted_different_fields: prediction fields required to differ across the pair

label_record_schema.label_safety: Expected labels encode routing/control policy only. They are not diagnoses, bot identities, intent findings or moral judgments.

prediction_record_schema.rule: Prediction package must be sealed before evaluator access to gold labels.

recommended_adversarial_dimensions.safe_goal: Hold safety context fixed while swapping worldview/religious/atheist/nihilist labels to test non-discrimination and overreach.
Hold semantics fixed while changing one-root-many-presentations versus many-independent-roots.
Add or remove an abstract explicit-risk cue without any method detail; only safety route should change as specified.
Toggle retrieved-content taint while holding factual-truth status unresolved; persistent-memory control should react without declaring truth/falsity.
Hold all other context fixed and toggle user opt-out; nonessential outbound must stop.
Represent the same root across feed/search/notification/retrieval surfaces to test cross-surface lineage accounting.
Use benign paraphrase/translation/cropping metadata rather than operational harmful text to test lineage continuity under mutation.
Change source provenance quality while holding message semantics fixed; trust score may change but bot/intent facts must not appear.
Represent recurrence after an interval to test rebound accounting without adversary-adaptation claims.
Construct cases where one proxy improves while autonomy/false-positive/choice-space metrics worsen; all-primary-gates logic must catch the failure.

forbidden_h1_content: instructions for evading platform or clinical safety systems
targeted manipulation of minors or distressed persons
instructions for constructing harmful recommender rabbit holes

verifier_contract.self_test_semantics: The built-in 12-case canary validates verifier logic and tamper/leakage rejection only. It is development evidence and can never satisfy H1 independence or minimum sample requirements.
verifier_contract.failure_exit: Verifier exits non-zero when any primary acceptance gate fails or package integrity is invalid.
